title: Memories from the House of Work
summary: A fragmented memoir of a place that can be read as a workplace or a closed institution. Through people, routines, hierarchy, performance, invisible labor, stolen ideas and silence, the narrator gradually discovers how a system can reshape the human being who enters it.

reality_weaving.imaginative_transformation: The workplace and the closed house overlap without either being named as the sole reality.
reality_weaving.emergent_question: When a person freely enters a system every day, where does obligation end and freedom begin?

links.note: The work house continues the Human-Centered Universe's exploration of how human beings create systems and are then reshaped by them.

tr.title: Çalışma Evinden Anılar
tr.summary: Bir işyeri ya da kapalı bir kurum olarak okunabilen bir mekânın parçalı anıları. İnsanlar, rutinler, hiyerarşi, performans, görünmeyen emek, sahiplenilen fikirler ve sessizlik üzerinden sistemin insanı nasıl dönüştürebildiği anlatılır.
